AXIS is a scientific decision system designed to make the reasoning between evidence, uncertainty and the next discriminating experiment explicit and auditable. In this case, it links source-scoped ERAP1 evidence to categorical assessments, competing explanations and conditional experimental consequences. It preserves distinctions between source assertions, calculations, inferences and proposed experiments. The present pack summarizes one frozen exploratory decision for expert criticism; it does not present AXIS as an autonomous scientist or treat automated reproducibility as scientific approval.
This is a request for independent scientific criticism, not endorsement.
We are not asking whether you endorse AXIS. We are asking where this scientific decision may be wrong.

Please seek factual errors, overclaims, material missing evidence within scope, inappropriate evidence transfer, flawed assay comparisons, mechanistic reasoning errors, incorrect uncertainty prioritization and weaknesses in the next experiment.
Read pages 2-5 for the decision in approximately 10 minutes. Use the questions, primary references and immutable repository links on pages 6-7 for a 30-60 minute audit.
AXIS has not been independently scientifically validated.

This document summarizes a frozen scientific decision analysis for independent review. It is not clinical guidance, evidence of therapeutic efficacy, regulatory advice, or an endorsement of ERAP1 as a validated therapeutic target.
Genetics → Mechanism → Structure → Chemistry → Cellular pharmacology → Target engagement → Disease translation

statement_audit.text: DECISION STABLE
Expanded evidence coverage did not change the critical uncertainty, next experiment or strategy identifiers. This is not a claim that all evidence or uncertainty states are unchanged.
Do the phenotype-producing compounds directly engage ERAP1 in cells at those exposures?
Matched-genotype chemical-genetic experiment with an engagement readout

Engagement at phenotype-active exposure, coupled to a matched null/rescue comparison, can strengthen or weaken compound-specific attribution. The proposal is not performed or investigator-approved; feasibility remains unknown.
Supporting continued investigation
ERAP1/HLA genetic associations motivate peptide-handling biology, not a prescribed intervention. [1,2]
Peptide trimming and HLA-B27 repertoire effects provide mechanistic context; cellular responses are system-specific. [3-6]
Allotype/substrate dependence is experimentally characterized and material to interpretation. [8,9]
Ligand-bound experimental regulatory-site structures and measured chemistry support design/tractability under recorded construct and assay contexts. [7,10-12]

BRADSHAW establishes defined Hap2/YTAFTIPSI biochemical activity and HeLa antigen-presentation pharmacology. Tinworth adds separate programme evidence; neither transfers occupancy to Maben compounds. [10-12]
Limiting the decision
Historical phenotype-producing Maben compounds lack demonstrated compound-specific direct cellular engagement in the curated decision. Off-target and indirect explanations remain viable. [7]
Biochemical inhibition, cellular antigen presentation, engagement and disease modification are different evidence classes.
Unreported context and allotype/substrate dependence restrict pooling and transfer. Chen and Tran report different free-heavy-chain directions in different systems. [5,6]
No established human axSpA therapeutic efficacy follows from these preclinical data. Independent review remains pending; no predictive model was trained.

statement_audit.text: HLA-B27-positive cell system with wild-type, ERAP1-depleted or null, and ERAP1-rescued arms in a matched genetic background. Compound at phenotype-active exposures versus vehicle and an inactive analogue in each arm; ERAP1 genetic depletion and re-expression as the genetic comparison.

Primary endpoint: Compound-dependent ERAP1 engagement at the exposures that produce the phenotype, together with phenotype attenuation in ERAP1-null cells. Context: report/match ERAP1 allotype; choose/report HLA-B27 subtype. Measure viability separately and use the same phenotype-active exposures.

Controls and feasibility: vehicle; matched ERAP1-null/depleted cells; rescue; inactive analogue only if established (none identified). No qualifying positive-control ligand is established in the curated corpus. Compound identity, engagement readout and null/rescue validation remain prerequisites; cost/time and local feasibility are unknown.

statement_audit.text: A single system does not establish patient relevance. Null/rescue is not partial pharmacological inhibition; selectivity against other proteins remains unresolved. No scenario has occurred in this reassessment.

The causal diff records expanded structural, chemical and cellular evidence coverage. Twelve source-mapped structures were added since canonical v1; these provide regulatory-site design context, not occupancy. [7,10-12]

Legitimate access to the BRADSHAW main article resolved the assay-identity blocker. Page 17/reference 22 explicitly links to Liddle 2020: purified Hap2, YTAFTIPSI cleavage and RapidFire MS. This chain supports constrained interpretation, not inferred equivalence based on programme similarity. [10,12]

Conservative BRADSHAW subsets retain 38 biochemical compounds/24 Murcko scaffolds and 31 cellular compounds/19 scaffolds. Scientific eligibility is MODEL_ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONDITIONS; no model was trained. Tinworth remains separate SAR-only evidence. [10,11]

Historical Maben compound-specific engagement remains unresolved. Biochemical potency does not establish cellular engagement; a cellular phenotype does not establish a therapeutic mechanism. Later programme evidence cannot supply occupancy for earlier compounds.

Critical uncertainty and the recommended chemical-genetic engagement experiment remain unchanged. Strategy identifiers are stable. No protective human peptide state, optimal modulation magnitude or human axSpA efficacy is established.

Unknown temperature, preincubation, dose range and tested form restrict exact replication and cross-programme comparison. HeLa ERAP1 allotype, ERAP2, endogenous HLA and control-inhibitor identity remain unconfirmed.

Compound 28 retains the main/SI discrepancy (cellular pIC50 5.3 versus 5.4). Censored occasions for 21/28/33/44, singleton observations and missing N are preserved and excluded where required for fitting. No bound becomes an exact value.

Source assertion: what a publication reports. AXIS observation: recorded extraction/calculation. AXIS inference: scoped interpretation. AI suggestion: competing explanations/experiment/scenarios. Researcher hypothesis: proposed mechanism. Experimental result: an observed performed experiment, not a prospective scenario. These kinds are not interchangeable; pending reviews remain pending.

The disease-model edge is SUPPORTED in v2 while clinical translation remains NOT_ASSESSED. Animal/cellular evidence is not human axSpA efficacy; the stable decision concerns the still-missing compound-specific engagement link.
